title: Unbelievably Indulgent Australian Shrimp Pie
description: A savory, fluffy, indulgent Australian dish featuring saeujeot-shrimp-paste and a dash-friendly glaze. Perfect for a special occasion.
instructions: Melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Add diced onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Add shrimp and cook until pink and just cooked through, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Stir in shrimp paste (saeujeot) and cook for 1 minute.
In a separate bowl, whisk together chicken broth, heavy cream, and paprika.
Add the wet ingredients to the skillet and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until slightly thickened, about 2-3 minutes.
In a separate bowl, mix together flour and egg until a dough forms.
Roll out the dough on a floured surface to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Transfer the dough to a 9-inch pie dish and fill with the shrimp mixture.
Top the pie with grated cheddar cheese and bake for 25-30 minutes, or until golden brown.
